tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// zhabs brtan gyi rim pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa tshe mchog bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs//

oṃ swasti/ phyogs bcu'i bder gshegs rgyal ba rab 'byams tshogs// gcig bsdus gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// 'chi med tshe dbang lhag pa'i lha rnams kyis// deng 'dir mi 'gyur tshe yi dngos grub stsol// dpa~Xl lda~Xn sgrub brgyud bsta~Xn pa~X'i rgya mtsho cher// nyi~Xn bye~Xd 'chi~X me~Xd lam las yongs shar ba// gru~Xb pa~X'i khyu~X mcho~Xg 'gro ba'i mun pa sel// phri~Xn la~Xs rgya~Xs pa~X'i dpal mnga' zhabs brtan gsol// gang gi gzhan phan 'od snang rab tu gsal// sde~X bzhi pad+mo'i ge sar rnam par bkra// skal ldan rkang drug thar pa'i lam ston mchog /byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhabs brtan gsol// dam pa khyod kyi thugs bskyed kun dga'i dpal// dam chos zab mo'i bdud rtsi'i klung bzang pos// skye dgu'i nyon mongs tsha gdung 'gog byed pa// smra ba'i dbang phyug bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol// mgon khyod don dam 'pho 'gyur bral mod kyang*// kun rdzob gdul bya'i snang ngor zhing 'di ru// gsang gsum mi shigs 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku// bskal pa rgya mtshor zhabs pad brtan gyur cig / ces 'jig rten gyi 'dren pa rgyal mchog phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba zhabs pad bskal pa du mar brtan pa'i phyir/ gang gi zhabs rdul skye ba kun tu mi 'bral bar gcig tu smon pa'i yid can si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos chu glang lo smin zla'i yar tshes dge bar grub pa'i gnas nas phul ba dge legs 'phel/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ dus gsum rgyal dang rgyal sras tshogs rnams kyis// deng 'dir byin rlabs thugs rje'i dngos grub stsol// gdod nas lhun grub bde chen rdo rje'i sku// zhing 'di'i ston mchog dam par bzhugs gsol 'debs// rim gsum chos kyi 'khor lo mtha' yas pas// 'gro kun legs pa'i lam mchog ston mdzad cing*// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug 'khor lo'i mgon// dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol// snying rje'i rang gzugs 'gro la rjes chags pa'i// byams pa chen po'i thugs bskyed gting mtha' yas// rgya chen phrin las yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal// kun gyi 'byung gnas dam par zhabs brtan gsol// gang sku skye med sgyu ma'i skur snang ba// 'pho 'gyur mtshan ma yongs su bral mod kyang*// zhing 'dir bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon mchog dam par// bskal pa du mar zhabs pad brtan bzhugs gsol// chos dbyings rang bzhin don dam bden pa dang*// chos can kun rdzob bslu med nus pa yis// sku bzhi'i bdag nyid chos kyi rgyal po gang*// bskal brgyar zhabs brtan phrin las rab rgyas shog

/ ces pa'ang srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan dam pa dpal karma pa chen po bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan pa'i ched du/ gang de'i bka' 'bangs si tu pas 'og min dpal gyi mtshur phu'i gan+dho la yi bya 'dabs su bris pa don ldan du gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ sras bcas rgya mtsho byang sems ma lus pa'i// thugs rje'i rang gzugs bde ldan zhing gi mgon// 'od snang mtha' yas mtsho skyes pad+ma 'byung*// rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje'i klong yangs nas// sgyu 'phrul gar ston sna tshogs 'od zer bzhin// ji snyed shes bya'i 'od kyi snang ba yis// log lta'i mun tshogs dra ba gtan nas bcom// bstan pa'i gsal byed bskal brgyar 'tsho gzhes gsol// yon tan rin chen kun gyi 'byung gnas gter// phun tshogs zab mo'i chos sgo mtha' yas kyis// 'gro rnams byang grol lam la bkod mdzad pa// tshad med snying rje'i dbang phyug 'tsho gzhes gsol// 'gyur med rdo rje lta bu'i sku mnga' ba// yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan tshangs pa'i gsung*// blo gros kun khyab mtha' mi mngon pa'i thugs// gsang gsum mi shigs bskal brgyar 'tsho gzhes gsol// mchog gsum ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i byin rlabs kyis// mgon khyod bstan 'gro'i dpal dang mgon dam par// bskal brgyar 'tsho zhing zhabs pad brtan gyur cig / ces khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bka' brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'gyur med yongs grub dam chos nyi ma'i sde zhabs pad rgya mtshor brtan pa'i phyir kwan ting tā yi si tus dpal gyi mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang nas gsol ba de bzhin re 'bras don ldan du gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ mi shigs rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i sku// rnam dag chos tshul nā da'i sgra dbyangs can// zab zhi spros bral ting 'dzin mchog brnyes pa'i// gsang gsum 'gyur med rdo rje brtan bzhugs gsol// mtha' bral zab mo'i gnas rnams ji snyed pa// 'gro khams mos ngor de snyed ston mkhas pa'i// gsung gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal dpa' bo che// dngos snang zhing 'dir chos ston 'tsho gzhes gsol// gsang sngags bla med zung 'jug snying po yi// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyi 'od 'bum brdal ba// bde gshegs kun gyis dbugs dbyung bsngags pa'i gnas// rnam 'dren 'jig rten mgon po zhabs brtan gsol// snang srid dbang bsgyur phrin las rgya chen gyi// rmad byung gzhan phan thugs bskyed dpal 'bar ba// ye shes grub gnyis byin rlabs stsol ba'i gnyen// pad+mā kā ra dbyer med rtag bzhugs gsol// don dam 'pho 'gyur mtshan ma bral mod kyang*// kun rdzob snang ba'i rigs gsum gdul bya'i ngor// 'chi med tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bo ru// bskal pa rgya mtshor zhabs pad brtan gyur cig

/ston pa mnyam med bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can// bka' brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'brug pa'i zhabs// sgo gsum 'dud do rnyed bkur sgrub pas mchod// nongs bshags yi rangs chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// mi 'gyur khri la mi g.yo bzhugs gsol 'debs// dus gsum dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo// 'gro mgon khyod dang 'bral med byin gyis rlobs// zhes bka' brgyud yongs kyi gtsug rgyan 'brug pa rin po che bka' brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gdod nas yongs grub dam chos nyi ma'i sde bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'di bzhin kwan ting tā'i si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos sa spyod gsung gi gnas mchog karma ri gling chos 'khor gyi gtsug lag tu gsol ba btab pa don dang ldan par gyur cig /dza ga taṃ/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ gang zhig dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i 'phrul// dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug rigs kun gyi// khyab bdag gdod nas lhun grub 'gyur med sku// theg pa mchog gi rdo rje 'tsho gzhes gsol// chos 'khor rim gsum mthar thug dgongs pa'i don// dwags po bka' brgyud nges don kaṃ tshang gi /bstan pa yongs rdzogs 'dzin pa'i thams cad mkhyen// gsang gsum rdo rje'i khams su brtan bzhugs gsol// o rgyan rdo rje'i bka' gsang chos kyi sgo// ji snyed gdul bya'i khams dbang mos pa'i ngor// ston pa'i bdag nyid bde chen 'khor lo'i mgon// zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtshor brtan gyur cig / ces rgyal mchog phyag na pad+ma 'chang ba gru 'dzin phreng ba rim byon las/ bcu bzhi pa theg pa mchog gi rdo rje zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs su/ si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis mtshur gan+dho lar bkod pa dge'o/// / ༈ 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /snying rje chen po'i thugs kyi klong yangs nas// gdul dka'i 'gro rnams yal bar ma dor slad// deng 'dir 'gro ba'i mgon po karma pa// gang dang dbyer med 'od snang mtha' yas kyi// sgyu 'phrul sprul pa'i zlos gar yongs shar ba// snyigs dus 'dren pa zhwa dmar con pan can// zhing 'dir zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan gsol 'debs// rgyal ba'i phrin las byed por dbang bskur ba// tā yi si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang*// pad+ma'i rnam rol dam chos kun 'byung gter// rig pa 'dzin dbang rdo rje drag po rtsal// zhing 'dir zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan gsol 'debs// bslu med dkon mchog kun 'dus ngo bo nyid// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// ma hā gu ru pad 'byung mthu stobs kyis// 'gro don phrin las nyin byed 'od stong gis// rgyal bstan pad tshal rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/ sho bu bla ma gang des bskul bzhin/ si tus spel/ dge legs 'phel rgyas shog// / ༈ lha dang bcas pa'i skye dgu'i rnam par 'dren// byang chub sems dpa' bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang*// bskal pa du mar zhing 'dir rtag bzhugs nas// bdag sogs gdul bya rjes su 'dzin mdzad gsol/ lha rgyal ngor spel/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti sid+dhan+tu/ gdod ma'i ye shes kun khyab klong yangs par// bde chen 'gyur med thugs rje'i rang bzhin las// ma 'gag sna tshogs rol pa'i gar sgyur mkhan// rang rig sku gsum dbyer med 'tsho gzhes gsol// mi g.yo rdo rje'i rang bzhin mtshan dpe'i sku// mi shigs rdo rje nā da'i dbyangs ldan gsung*// mi rtog rdo rje'i ting 'dzin mnga' ba'i thugs// mi 'gyur rdo rje'i khri la 'tsho gzhes gsol// chos nyid don dam bden pa'i stobs dag dang*// chos can kun rdzob rten 'brel bslu med bden// deng 'dir dag gtsang dam tshig rnam dag mthus// bskal brgyar 'tsho gzhes zhabs pad brtan gyur cig / ces pa'ang gangs can lha gcig rje btsun 'brug pa rin po che bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs bden tshigs su/ gang gi slob 'bangs si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos 'dzin byed ces pa me byi lo'i nag zla'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba dang po'i tshes la bkod de phul ba sarba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan ye shes rang byung nge~Xs pa'i do~Xn// lhu~Xn gyis gru~Xb pa bsta~Xn pa~X'i nyi~Xn mor bye~Xd// mi~X pha~Xm thugs rje'i 'od zer 'bum brdal ba// khams gsum cho~Xs kyi rgya~Xl por zhabs brtan gsol// gdo~Xd na~Xs 'chi med yo~Xngs gru~Xb ngo bo nyid// yid srubs phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i gzis// sde bzhi'i pad tshal phyogs bcur rgyas bzhin par// bskal mang 'tsho gzhes phrin las mthar phyin shog /chos dbyings rtag pa dam pa'i bden pa dang*// chos can kun rdzob rten 'brel bslu med bden// bden pa'i bden tshig mthu stobs rmad byung bas// re ba'i shing rta yongs su gang gyur cig

/ ces bka' brgyud bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan gangs ljongs 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan 'brug pa rin po che'i mchog gi sprul sku nyin byed gsar du tshes pa'i zhabs brtan 'di nyid gu ru'i lung zin du rlom pa/ si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis rje dbon mi pham bstan 'dzin phrin las rnam par rgyal ba gang des bskul ngor gsol ba btab pa dge legs su gyur cig /maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ bslu med rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs mchog /dpa~Xl lda~Xn sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung*// dpa' bo'i dbang phyug rta mchog he ru ka /'chi med lha yis dge legs mchog sbyin mdzod// lhun grub rtag brtan gzhom bral rdo rje'i khrir// gsang gsum g.yo med 'gyur ba med pa'i sku// phrin las gzi yis log smra'i mun tshogs bcom// bstan 'gro phan bde'i gzhir gyur zhabs brtan gsol// dwags brgyud snying po dri med pad dkar gyi// ring lugs 'dab stong phyogs bcur rgya~Xs pa~X'i phyir// dam ldan chos srung dkar po'i sde~X skyong ba// mthu ldan dregs pa'i tshogs kyis phrin las sgrubs// 'gro mgon rje btsun bla ma sprul pa'i sku'i// dam pa chos kyi bdud rtsi'i char chen gyis// skal bzang thar pa'i myu gu skyed byed pa// gtsu~Xg la~Xg cho~Xs kyi rgya~Xl po zhabs brtan gsol// mchog gsum rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan karma pa yi byin rlabs dang*// lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu'i nus rtsal gyis// smon pa'i bden tshig yongs su 'grub mdzad gsol// zhes grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun mchog gi sprul pa'i sku zhabs pad bskal pa du mar brtan pa'i phyir/ gang de'i nye gnas pa karma bde chen gyis rten dang bcas bskul bar cho 'phrul can gyi yar tshes la 'og min mtshur phu nas gsol ba dge legs 'phel/// / ༈ rgyal ba kun 'dus 'chi med pad+ma// rgyal kun skyed yum yid bzhin 'khor lo// tshe yi dbang phyug lha mchog rnams kyis// tshe yi dngos grub 'gyur med rdo rje// gzhom bral mi shigs rtag brtan ngo bor// gzhom bral gsang gsum nyin byed dbang po// dpal ldan snying po'i don brgyud gsal byed// dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar bzhugs gsol// mgon khyod gdod nas lhun grub brnyes kyang*// mgon khyod kun rdzob 'gro blo'i mos ngor// phrin las snang bas phyogs mthar kun khyab// phrin las rab rgyas bkra shis dge legs//

de ltar rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las gdugs dkar srid rtser bsgrengs pa bla ma dam pa rdo rje drag po bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan phyir/ si tus spel ba su dza ya/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ rgyal sras mtsho skyes kun mkhyen pad+ma rgyal// rgyal kun rnam rol mtshungs med chos kyi rgyal// mchog gi gsang gsum rdo rje'i rang bzhin can// mchog tu 'gyur med khams su brtan gyur cig /chos 'khor zab mo'i bdud rtsi dam pa'i chos// chos sgo ji snyed skal bar 'tshams pa'i chos// ston pa'i rgyal thabs dam pa srid zhi'i dpal// ston mchog zhabs brtan phrin las rgyas gyur cig / ces tshangs pa lha yi me tog bka' brgyud bstan pa'i sgron mer gyur pa rdo rje drag po'i brtan bzhugs sgrub brgyud dar rgyas gling gi rtogs ldan rnams kyi zhal 'don khyer bder tā'i si tus bkod pa maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje'i mkha' klong nas// 'gro la rjes brtse'i snying rje'i rang rtsal mdangs// rgyal kun phrin las mi zad gter chen po// 'phags chen phyag na pad+mo'i rnam par rol// dus gsum thogs med sprul bsgyur du ma yis// mtha' yas gdul bya rjes su 'dzin gyur pa'i// thugs rje tshad med srid pa'i mtsho sgrol ba// skye dgu'i 'dren pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog /mi 'gyur g.yung drung khri la mi shigs dang*// gsang gsum rdo rje'i rang bzhin brtan gyur te// byang chen thugs bskyed go cha che bzhes nas// zhing 'dir bskal pa 'byams klas brtan bzhugs gsol// zhes pa'ang rgyal mchog bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang gang slar yang sprul pa'i zla zhal 'char ba'i gtam rna ba'i bdud rtsi thos skabs grub pa'i rjes 'dzin ras sprul shes rab rgya mtsho'i bzhed ltar si tus spel ba dza ga taṃ/// / ༈ 'gyur med gdod nas rgyal kun gsang gsum gyi// yon tan mtha' klas gcig bsdus rin chen 'byung// mtshan dpe lhun po'i phrin las mngon mtho ba// the~Xg pa~X mcho~Xg gi~X snang byed zhabs brtan gsol// thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gzhung lugs gaṅgā'i klung*// gcig gyur nges gsang ring lugs rma med pa// skye dgu'i skyabs su nub med 'dzin pa'i bdag

/rdo rje'i chos bdun rang bzhin zhabs brtan gsol// ji snyed bskal par gdul bya'i snang ngo ru// de snyed sprul sku'i bkod pa 'di kho na// tshe 'od mgon bzhin rtag brtan lhun grub kyi// ngo bor 'tsho gzhes zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /

ces pa'ang gangs can mgon po rgyal mchog bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje bsam bzhin skye ba'i zlos gar gsar du bzhad pa'i skabs bslab gsum nor ldan bla ma sprul sku'i bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ gdod nas rtag brtan rdo rje lhun grub kyi// rang bzhin mchog la gnas kyang gdul bya'i ngor// mi shigs mi 'gyur bskal brgyar 'tsho gzhes nas// thugs bskyed zab mo'i phrin las snang ba yis// bstan 'gro'i dge legs dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shing*// thub bstan 'khor lo gsum gyi dgongs pa'i don// nyams med yun gnas gnyug mar gnas rnams kyang*// dam chos bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis 'tsho gyur cig / ces gcod yul ba karma ye shes kyi bzhed ltar/ rgyal ba'i mchog sprul gsar 'char gyi zhabs brtan du si tus spel/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ gdod nas rang byung zag med bde chen dbyings// sgyu 'phrul gar ston the~Xg mcho~Xg bla med kyi// rdo~X rje~X 'dzin dbang zlos gar sprul pa'i sku// gsang gsum 'gyur med rtag brtan yongs grub shog /'gro la phan bde'i gzhir gyur sman stsol ba// sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu'i thugs bskyed kyi// 'jug pa zab mo'i phrin las rgyas mdzad pa// gsang gsum mi 'gyur rdo rjer lhun grub shog /mchog gsum rab 'byams bden pa zab mo dang*// chos dbyings rang bzhin don dam bden pa yis// gzhom bral rdo rje'i khri la g.yo med par// tshe 'od mgon bzhin bskal brgyar brtan gyur cig / ces pa'ang bslab gsum nor ldan 'brug skyid phug pa tshul khrims dar rgyas bzhed ltar rgyal ba'i zhabs brtan du si tus spel ba dge// / ༈ bskal mang thugs bskyed rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs las// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i rol gar yid bzhin dbang*// tshangs dbang gtsug gi rgyan du mchod pa gang*// 'tsho gzhes srid mtha'i bar du brtan gyur cig /zab mo'i phrin las 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang bzhin// 'bad med lhun grub don gnyis dngos grub char// skal bzang yid mkhar mngon sum skyed mdzad pa// thar lam ston mchog srid mthar brtan gyur cig

/gsang gsum yon tan rgya mtsho'i rang bzhin can// mi shigs g.yung drung mi nub rdo rje'i khrir// bstan 'gro'i dpal dang mgon po dam pa ru// mi nub rgyal mtshan ji bzhin brtan gyur cig / ces pa'ang gter ston lhun grub rab brtan gyis dpal karma pa'i zla zhal gsar du 'char ba'i zhabs brtan bskul bzhin si tus spel/// / ༈ nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod yongs rdzogs pa// bcom ldan tshe 'od ye shes snang mtha' yas// rnam rol 'phags yul grub pa mchog rnams dang*// gangs ljongs bstan 'dzin skyes rabs phreng ba las// tshar du dngar ba rje btsun sprul pa'i sku// gang 'dir rgyal dbang karma'i ring lugs kyi// shing rta chen por thugs bskyed yongs grub pa'i// phrin las phyogs mthar rgyas bzhin zhabs brtan gsol// mkhas btsun bzang grub dam pa'i skyes bu yi// rnam thar rmad byung 'dzin spel bstan dang 'gro'i// don rnams mthar phyin gsang gsum mi 'gyur ba// gzhom bral rdo rje'i khams su brtan gyur cig / ces si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis dge slong karma dbang rgyal ngor/ zhabs drung tre ho rin po cher zhabs brtan bden tshigs su spel ba dge// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ gdod nas 'pho 'gyur bri gang las 'das shing*// bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin 'dus ma byas// rgyal kun spro dang bsdu ba'i gzhir gyur pa// 'phags chen phyag na pad+mo zhabs brtan gsol// brdar btags ngag gi lam 'das chos kyi sku// ye nas ye shes nam mkha'i rang bzhin can// skye 'gags gnas bral rtag pa'i rdo rje dngos// chos dbyings mtha' bral klong du zhabs brtan gsol// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba spyi dang ni// lhag par sgrub brgyud kaṃ tshang ring lugs nyid// phyogs dang tha grur khyab pa'i byed po ru// bskal dang bskal par zhabs pad brtan par gsol// zhes rgyal dbang rin po che bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan pa'i rten 'byung ched du si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bkod pa dge bar gyur cig

/shu bhaṃ/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ gang zhig dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i 'phrul// dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug rigs kun gyi// khyab bdag gdod nas lhun grub 'gyur med sku// the~Xg pa mcho~Xg gi rdo~X rje~X 'tsho gzhes gsol// chos 'khor rim gsum mthar thug dgongs pa'i don// dwags po bka' brgyud nges don kaṃ tshang gi /bstan pa yongs rdzogs 'dzin pa'i thams cad mkhyen// gsang gsum rdo rje'i khams su brtan bzhugs gsol// o rgyan rdo rje'i bka' gsang chos kyi sgo// ji snyed gdul bya'i khams dbang mos pa'i ngor// ston pa'i bdag nyid bde chen 'khor lo'i mgon// zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtshor brtan gyur cig / ces rgyal mchog phyag na pad+ma 'chang ba gru 'dzin phreng ba rim byon las/ bcu bzhi pa theg pa mchog gi rdo rje zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis mtshur gan+dho lar bkod pa dge// / ༈ tshe dang ye shes dpag med bcom ldan 'das// sgyu 'phrul rnam par rgyal ma lha mo'i sku// thugs rje tshad med yid bzhin 'khor lo yi// byin rlabs 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gru char ni// gang 'dir sim pa'i legs byas dpal de yis// mi shigs dwangs ma rdo rje'i sku brnyes shing*// bslab gsum rgyud smin thos sgom mthar phyin nas// bstan dang 'gro don lhun gyis 'grub gyur cig / ces si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis gter sprul gsar bzhad la karma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin bzang po mtshan dang yun 'tsho'i bden tshig /gang de'i dbon sprul karma rab sgrub kyis bzhed ltar spel ba dge// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba yongs 'dus karma pa'i// ring lugs phrin las shing rtar dbang bsgyur ba'i// sprul pa'i rol gar ston gang 'tsho gzhes shing*// gzhom bral 'gyur med khams su lhun 'grub shog /bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i gzhi brtan cing*// bsdu dngos bzhi dang 'phags nor bdun la sogs// chos tshul spyod la nyer 'tsho'i gegs bral bar// 'gro don rlabs chen mtha' ru phyin par shog

/ ces si tu pas gcod bla tshe dbang bzhed ngor bsod chos sprul skur yun 'tsho'i ched du spel ba dge// / ༈ tshe dang ye shes dpag med bcom ldan 'das// sgyu 'phrul gar ston yid bzhin 'khor lo yum// rnam par rgyal ma la sogs rtsa ba gsum// byin rlabs thugs rje'i dbyings las 'chi med kyi// bdud rtsis dam pa'i sgyu 'phrul pad+ma dkar// yongs su bran mthus gsang gsum mi shigs pa// gdod ma'i rdo rje gsum dngos brtan gyur pas// bka' brgyud bstan pa rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ tshe dbang ye shes 'gyur med gdod nas grub// tshe brtan mgon gyur pad+ma sam+bha wa// tshe yi lha tshogs rab 'byams zhing gang bas// tshe dpal snang ba rab rgyas dge legs stsol// sku mchog gser gyi lhun po bzhin tu brtan// gsung gsang mi shigs grags snyan chos rnga sprin// thugs ni mi g.yo ting 'dzin brgya phrag mnga'// gsang gsum mi 'gyur bskal brgyar 'tsho gzhes brtan// nges don snying po'i rgyal bstan nyin mor byed// 'dzin skyong spel ba'i phrin las shing rta yis// 'gro kun phan bde'i 'od stong spro bzhin tu// rtag par bkra shis kun tu khyab par shog / ces pa'ang sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyan gyur dam pa dbon sprul phrin las rab rgyas gang der brtan bzhugs su si tu'i ming nas yar tshes bzang por bris pa dza yan+tu/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ mchog gsum ngo bo mtsho skyes pad 'byung gi /nges gsang ring lugs dri med 'dab stong can// phyogs bcur spel mkhas dkon mchog 'byung gnas dang*// dbyer med zab gter mnga' bdag klong gsal snying*// mgon de'i sgyu 'phrul gar gyi rol pa las// rgyal bstan gsal byed dbang gi rdo rje gang*// mtha' klas bskal pa'i bar du 'tsho gzhes nas// phrin las 'dzin ma'i khyon kun 'gengs mdzad gsol// tshul der snang ba'i log pa'i blo can rnams// rmeg med nyid du thal bar brlag gyur cig

/dge legs grags snyan ba dan srid pa'i rtser// mi nub rtag par rab brtan 'phel rgyas shog / ces pa'ang dad nor ldan pa bsod nams dbang rgyal ngor si tus spel ba dza ga taṃ/// / ༈ rgyal kun thugs rje'i rnam rol pad+ma 'byung*// tshe dbang rig 'dzin grub pa'i tshogs rnams dang*// rtsa gsum lha yis deng 'dir 'chi med kyi// bdud rtsi dam pa'i dpal gyis 'tsho gyur cig /nges gsang dri med snying po dwags brgyud kyi// bstan pa mi nub srid rtser bsgreng ba'i slad// grags snyan dbyar gyi rnga chen ldir bzhin du// chos kyi rgyal srid skyong bzhin 'tsho gyur cig /don dam 'gyur med rtag brtan lhun grub kyang*// kun rdzob snang ngor bskal brgyar 'tsho gzhes nas// bstan 'gro'i rgud pa'i mun pa drungs phyung ste// yang dag snang ba'i 'od stong spro gyur cig / ces grub pa'i dbang phyug gar dbang rin po che'i zhabs brtan 'di bzhin brtson 'grus kyis bskul ltar si tus spel ba maṅga lam/// / ༈ tshe dang 'od snang dpag med pa// tshe 'phel ār+ya tā re ma// tshe sbyin rnam par rgyal ma sogs// tshe la dbang ba'i lha rnams kyis// deng 'dir 'chi med mchog stsol mdzod// dam cho~Xs skyo~Xng ba'i 'dren pa gang*// 'gyu~Xr me~Xd rtag brtan 'tsho gzhes shing*// phri~Xn la~Xs snang ba ra~Xb rgya~Xs shog /rgyal dbang karma'i ring lugs ni// skye dgu'i bsod nams dpal gyur cing*// nub med yun tu brtan pa dang*// 'gro rnams myang 'das che thob shog / bla ma bstan pas bzhed ltar spel ba dge bar gyur cig// / ༈ tshe dang ye shes dpag med la sogs pa'i// dkon mchog rtsa gsum bden pa chen po yis// rgyal bstan gsal mdzad mchog tu smin pa'i sku// ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho 'tsho gyur smon// mkhas tshul gsum sogs dam pa'i tshul bzang pos// sgrub brgyud gtsor gyur rgyal ba'i bstan pa kun// spel ba'i phrin las mi nub dbyar gyi chu// yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin du gong 'phel shog

/ ces mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam thar rmad du byung ba kong po baṃ steng pa'i skye srid karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho gang der ring 'tsho'i smon tshig tu si tu pad+ma'i ming gis dge bar spel/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ chos dbyings 'gyur med bde chen sgyu 'phrul gar// thugs rje'i rol pa sna tshogs cir yang ston// mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyis spras pa'i skur snang ba// mthong bas rnam dag lam ston 'tsho gzhes gsol// rgyal kun gsung gi gsang ba'i bdag po mchog /yan lag drug cu'i chos sgo ji snyed kyi// de snyed gdul bya'i khams dbang mos pa'i ngor// thos pas yang dag don gnas 'tsho gzhes gsol// thugs mchog rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin ldan// sgrib bral ye shes rang snang mngon du gyur// dran pas ngan 'gro'i 'jigs kun sel ba'i mgon// zhing 'dir bskal brgyar 'tsho gzhes brtan gyur cig / rgyal dbang mchog sprul gyi zhabs brtan du phul ba dge// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal kun phrin las kyi// snang ba'i 'od zer gcig bsdus pa// pad 'byung nyin mo'i mgon po yis// bstan 'gro rgud pa'i mun tshogs gzhil// karma bka' brgyud ring lugs kyi// shing rta rig grol 'dus pa kun// rgya mtsho'i gos can yongs su khyab// bshad sgrub 'khor lo'i ljon bzang po// gegs med lhun gyis grub gyur te// skye dgu'i dpal du ji srid bar// nam yang g.yo med 'tsho gzhes nas// kun kyang byang chub lam ston shog / ces 'brug pa bla ma karma rig grol rgya mtsho yun 'tsho'i rten 'byung bskul bzhin spel/// / ༈ ston mchog zhi ba chags bral tshogs kyi mchog /mnyam med chos dbyings bden pa zab mo yis// deng 'dir bstan 'gro'i gsos smin sprul pa'i sku// bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal gyur nas// spangs rtogs yon tan bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar gang*// cha shas yongs rdzogs gdul bya ku muta kyi// thar pa'i lam gyi 'dab grol gnyen dam par// bskal par yun du 'tsho zhing brtan gyur cig

/ ces sgrub pa dkar po'i skye sprul gsar du bzhad skabs gang de'i 'dus sde rnams kyi ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal kun 'dus gzugs pad+ma 'byung*// lnga bdo'i dus 'dir khyad par gyi// thugs rjes 'gro la rjes chags pa'i// bstan pa'i nyi 'od 'bul brdal ba'i// de phyir sprul pa'i gter ston gyi// 'dul ba'i dus babs yol med par// brgyud pa dgu ldan byin rlabs mchog /deng 'dir myur du smin gyur nas// bstan 'gro'i don kun lhun grub cing*// bskal brgyar rab tu zhabs brtan shog / bla ma phrin las rab rgyas ngor spel/// / ༈ swa sti/ chos dbyings kun khyab rang bzhin gdod ma'i mgon// sku gsum ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can// bla med rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa yis// deng 'dir dge legs dpal yon lhun grub stsol// gang sku tshogs gnyis gser gyi bang rim mtho// gsung gsang zab mo'i chos kyi 'od brgya 'phro// thugs mchog rnam par mi rtog ye shes rgyas// gsang gsum bskal par zhing 'dir 'tsho gzhes gsol// bden pa'i bdag nyid bcom ldan sangs rgyas dang*// chags bral 'phags tshogs thugs rje'i gru char gyis// rmad byung phan bde'i gsos su yongs smin nas// bkra shis rdzogs ldan dga' ston gsal gyur cig / ces pa'ang mtshungs med dam pa rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che'i zhabs brtan bden tshig rten 'byung du spel/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ chos dbyings 'od gsal bde chen snying po'i khams// sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rnam rol sprul pa'i sku// mchog tu mi 'gyur don gyi ye shes kyi// snang ba'i nyin byed bskal brgyar 'tsho gyur cig /gzhan skyon mtshan mas ring spong yang dag gi /zab don theg gsum bla med nges pa'i don// ji bzhin ston pa'i rdo rje slob dpon che// 'od dkar bdud rtsi spel bzhin 'tsho gyur cig /rgyal rnams thugs rje'i spyi bcud yongs smin pa// gang 'dul phrin las ngo bor lhun grub pa'i// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal mnga' ba// ston pa'i rgyal thabs dam par 'tsho gyur cig

//de ltar lhag bsam gyis mtshon ku mud+da'i// phreng spel legs byas dge legs kyis bskul ba'i// rnam mang dus gsum rgyal ba'i nus stobs kyis// ji ltar smon pa de bzhin 'grub gyur cig / ces pa'ang skyabs rje 'dzi sgar rin po che'i mchog snang gsar 'char skabs/ gang de'i phrin las pa dpal dga' sprul sku tshe dbang bstan 'dzin dpal bzang gi bzhed ngor si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel/// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal kun thugs rje'i gter chen po// mtshor 'khrungs pad+ma 'byung gnas byin rlabs kyi// cha shas mos thob pad+ma nyin byed dbang*// bskal mang smon lam ji bzhin de ltar gyis// nges gsang mthar thug 'od gsal snying po'i bstan// nyams med yun gnas lhag bsam zla snang dkar// mi mthun bar chad chu 'dzin ring du bsrings// bstan 'gro'i don skyong 'od kyis tha grur khyab// bskal mang zhing 'dir 'tsho gzhes brtan gyur nas// zab don rim gnyis bcud kyi bdud rtsi yis// rang gzhan rgyud brlan byang chub 'bras smin cing*// rtag tu bsam don lhun grub bkra shis kyi// dpal 'bar he ru ka dpal rdo rje ber// mchog gi gsang gsum dbyer med sgrub brgyud bstan// spel phyir tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bo ru// mi shigs mi 'gyur mi nub zhabs brtan shog /

ces pa'ang rnal 'byor bi dza ya'i ngor spel/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan don kun yongs grub bcom ldan 'das// dpal mchog phyogs bcu'i bder gshegs ma lus pa'i// dpal kun gcig bsdus mtsho skyes pad+ma 'byung*// dpal 'bar dge legs dngos grub zla rgyas stsol// mi shigs yongs grub bde chen ngo bo ru// mi 'gyur gsang gsum gzhom bral rdo rje'i sku// mi g.yo rtag brtan rang bzhin g.yung drung khams// mi nub rgyal mtshan lta bur sgyu 'phrul gyi// rol pa 'di yang bskal pa bskal pa'i bar// sgrub brgyud ring lugs phrin las ba dan dkar// phyogs mthar bsgrengs ba'i thugs bskyed rmad byung ba// deng 'dir 'bad med yid bzhin 'grub par shog /dri med nges gsang rdo rje snying po yi// bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'tsho gzhes zhabs brtan cing*// bslab gsum nor ldan dge 'dun 'dus pa rgyas// mi mthun g.yul rgyal rnam kun bkra shis shog / ces pa'ang dad gsum mngon par mtho ba yongs dge sprul sku nas rten dang bcas bskul ba'i ngor/ bka' brgyud bstan pa'i phrin las pa chen po lha thog rje drung 'gyur med kyi mchog sprul dang*/ sar gnas byang sems ngo bo sras po bla ma bcas kyi zhabs brtan du si tus spel/// ༈ skyabs gsum 'dus pa rdo rje can// pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs rje'i mthus// nges gsang ring lugs rma med pa// 'dzin skyong phrin las dpal yon 'chang*// dbang gi rdo rje gsang ba gsum// mi shigs g.yung drung ngo bo ru// bskal pa las kyang bskal pa'i bar// 'tsho gzhes zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /de mthus bdag kyang rnam kun tu// bsam pa lhun gyis grub pa dang*// rang byung ye shes mthar phyin nas// sku bzhi'i bdag nyid 'gyur bar shog / rig 'dzin bsam 'phel nas bskul ngor spel/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ mchog gsum 'dus zhal rgyal ba rgyal ba'i gtso// dpal ldan rigs rnams khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon// gangs can mgon po phyag na pad dkar can// karma ka zhes gang des bde legs stsol// de yang mdo sngags bstan gnyis zab mo'i srol// dri med gces spras 'dzin pa'i dpal mnga' ba// mi 'gyur rdo rje can zhes grags de yi// sprul pa'i snang brnyan gang khyod rtag pa ru// gsang gsum 'gyur med ri dbang lhun po bzhin// rtag brtan bskal mang 'tsho gzhes brtan gyur nas// mtha' klas srid mtsho ma skem de srid du// thugs bskyed dam bca'i khur chen yol med shog

/ ces pa'ang rig 'dzin mchog gi sprul skur shis brjod du si tus spel ba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ dpa~Xl lda~Xn sgrub brgyud kaṃ tshang nges don gyi// 'gyu~Xr me~Xd bsta~Xn pa 'dzi~Xn la mnga' brnyes pa// phyo~Xgs rnams kun la~Xs rna~Xm gro~Xl phrin las can// pa~Xd+ma~X kā ra ji bzhin zhabs brtan shog /nyi~Xn bye~Xd gsang gsum yon tan dpal 'bar bas// tshangs dang dba~Xng po~X'i sde~X sogs gus pa'i gnas// dgos 'byung dba~Xng gi~X rgyal bzhin rdo~X rje~X gsum// 'tsho gzhes gsol 'debs 'gro rnams byang chen lam// bkod pa'i phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub nas// bskal brgyar g.yo med zhabs pad brtan gyur cig / ces dngos cag sprul sku rnams kyi zhabs brtan du phur sgrub bla ma bstan pa dar rgyas kyi ngor spel ba shu bha puṣ+ṭiṃ/// / ༈ bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya'i rgyal// dbyer med sangs rgyas pad skyes ring lugs kyi// don brgyud mthar thug nges gsang bstan pa'i bdag /gru 'dzin bdag po karma ka des skyongs// gang 'dir bstan dang 'gro la phan bde'i gzhir// ring nas thugs bskyed zab mos nyer grub pa'i// gzugs sku bskal par 'tsho brtan rnam kun du// gzhan rkyen nongs pa'i dri ma rgyang bsring shog /gsang gsum rdo rje'i khams su lhun grub nas// rtag par byang sems dam pa'i ngang tshul gyi// phrin las bzang pos skye dgu smin grol lam// bkod pa'i gzhan don mtha' ru phyin gyur cig / ces pa'ang bkram drung pa sprul pa'i sku'i zhabs brtan du sku zhang bla ma tshe dbang rnam rgyal gyi bzhed ltar si tus spel ba dge// / ༈ rab 'byams zhing bdag rgyal ba tshe mtha' yas// rdo rje gsum bdag 'chi med lha yi tshogs// deng 'dir don kun yongs su grub pa'i char// byin rlabs mchog stsol bde legs kun dgar mdzod// rigs kun khyab bdag bde chen 'khor lo'i mgon// dpal ldan rdo rje can dngos grub pa'i gtso// bka' brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa gang*// gdod nas yongs grub rtag brtan 'tsho gzhes gsol// dam chos nyi ma'i sde zhes grags snyan gyi// sprin sgras phyogs kyi mdangs ldan yid sim slad// bskal pa las kyang bskal chen bgrang yas par// mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rang bzhin zhabs brtan gsol// de ltar dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs brtan cing*// bdag sogs rnams kyang tshe dpal chos ldan zhing*// bsam pa'i don gnyis mtha' ru phyin pa yi// bkra shis kun khyab rtag brtan rab rgyas shog

/ ces pa'ang dpal ldan 'brug pa rin po che mchog gi rdo rje 'dzin dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs su/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos gus pas gsol ba btab pa'o// maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rgyal dang sras// thugs rje'i gter chen mgon po tshe mtha' yas// 'chi med rdo rje lha yi mchog rnams kyis// dpal 'bar dngos grub shis pa stsol gyur cig /bka' brgyud ring lugs phrin las snang byed bdag /'gro la sman pa'i yon tan rang bzhin can// dkyil 'khor kun bdag rdo rje 'dzin dbang po// bskal chen ring du zhabs brtan 'tsho gzhes gsol// dkon mchog kun 'dus bla ma'i thugs bskyed dang*// yi dam lha dang chos srung mthu byin gyis// deng 'dir smon pa yongs grub 'bras smin zhing*// rtag par bde legs bsam don lhun grub shog / ces pa'ang rigs dkyil bdag po gar dbang chos skyong 'gyur med mchog gi zhabs pad ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung ched/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ dpa~Xl lda~Xn 'chi med rdo rje lha'i dkyil 'khor// yongs bsdus 'chi~X me~Xd pa~Xd+ma~X'i byin rlabs kyis// gang 'dir 'chi med tshe dngos grub pa yi// rtag brtan 'chi med yongs grub dge legs stsol// gsang gsum mi 'gyur gzhom bral 'tsho gzhes shing*// thugs bskyed zab mos bsta~Xn pa~X'i phrin las kyi// 'dod dgur bsgyur bzhin gdul bya'i las skal dang*// 'tshams pa'i chos 'khor bskor bzhin brtan bzhugs gsol// bdag sogs dad dang dam tshig rnam dag dang*// chos can chos nyid bden pa'i stobs chen pos// gang khyod bdud bzhi las rgyal bzhed don kun// lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis ra~Xb rgya~Xs shog / ces karma chags med mchog sprul yun 'tsho'i rten 'byung du drung ngam bla ma'i bzhed ngor si tu pas spel ba maṅga laṃ/// /

༈ dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol rgyal dang rgyal// phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas lha yi tshogs// gang 'dir mi 'gyur 'chi med dngos kun gyi// dga' char dam pa'i snang ba stsol gyur cig /dpal ldan nges gsang bstan pa'i rgyan gyur pa'i// gang de'i gsang gsum gzhom bral rdo rje ltar// lhun grub phrin las dpal gzi 'bar bzhin du// zhing 'dir 'tsho gzhes chos ston bzhugs gsol 'debs// rgyal bstan snying po rab rgyas de 'dzin gyi// skyes mchog zhabs brtan dge 'dun sde 'phel zhing*// yul ris bde legs rdzogs ldan lang tsho rgyas// bkra shis kun tu khyab cing rab brtan shog / ces pa'ang tshe dbang rab 'byor bzhed ltar karma bde chen sprul sku'i zhabs brtan du spel/// / ༈ chos dbyings gdod ma'i gnas lugs don dam pa// rang byung lhan skyes gnyug ma spros bral ngang*// 'gyur med bde ba chen po'i rang mdangs kyi// rtsal snang ma 'gag sprul sgyur gar rol pa// cir yang ston pa'i rnam 'phrul gzugs kyi sku// tshar du dngar ba'i 'gro sgrol ded dpon che// gang khyod gdul bya snyigs lngar ches dgongs nas// snying stobs dpa' ba'i stobs kyis gsang ba gsum// mi shigs 'gyur med gshis kyi rang bzhin la// nam yang g.yo med byis blo'i snang ngo ru// gzhan rkyen mtshan mas mi bskyod bde ldan mgon// ji ltar zhabs brtan bstan 'gror dge legs shog / ces pa'ang rtogs ldan rab 'byor ngor bde chen snying po'i sprul sku'i zhabs brtan du spel/// / ༈ 'chi med bcom ldan lha yi lhar gyur pa// tshe dang 'od snang mtha' yas pad+ma 'byung// mchog dngos grub pa'i sar bzhugs rgyal dang rgyal// gang rnams thugs rjes ring du skyong gyur cig /dpal ldan karma'i ring lugs skyong ba dang*// lus can nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur mchod gnas su// gang de'i zlos gar snang ba gsal 'di dag

/'phral yun bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal 'tsho brtan shog /bstan pa'i phrin las gzhan don ji snyed pa// gegs med yongs su grub pa'i dpal thob cing*// mi 'gyur rdo rje'i ngo bor rtag brtan nas// don gnyis mthar phyin rnam kun bde legs shog / 'ja' mo sprul sku yun 'tsho'i bden tshig dbang 'dzin gyis bskul ngor spel/// / ༈ mchog gsum rgya mtsho'i thugs rje'i mkha' klong nas// phrin las phan bde'i nyi ma rab gsal ba// gang zhig nyes pa'i mun tshogs kun 'joms pa'i// rmad byung 'od snang zer phreng spro gyur cig /thugs bskyed dpyid kyi dpal las grub pa yi// gzugs sku'i pad tshal bslab gsum dri bsung ldan// yid can bung tshogs 'du zhing rgyal bstan gyi// mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur deng 'dir 'tsho brtan shog /sgrub brgyud ring lugs phyogs mthar khyab yun gnas// bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan dge 'dun sde rgyas shing*// rgyal khams bde zhing dkar phyogs skyong rnams kyis// rtag tu dge ba'i dpal yon stsol gyur cig / gar bstan bya btang mkhan slob nas bzhed ngor ras sprul yun 'tsho'i bden tshig tu spel/// / ༈ tshe dang ye shes yon tan dpag med mgon// dus gsum rgyal kun skyed yum sgrol ma dkar// rnam par rgyal sogs 'chi med mchog ster lhas// gang 'dir dge legs snang ba 'bar gyur cig /bstan 'gro'i phan dang bde 'byung kun gyi gzhi// yongs grub sngon smon ji bzhin sprul pa'i sku// mi mthun nyer 'tshe'i tshogs las rab grol nas// zhing 'dir rtag par g.yo med 'tsho gzhes shog /gzhan don phrin las yar zla ltar 'phel zhing*// sgrub brgyud ring lugs dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// dge 'dun thugs mthun chos spyod bcu dang ldan// skye dgu bde skyid dpal gyis dge gyur cig / pad snying skye sprul yun 'tshor gang de'i dbon rigs nas bskul ltar spel/// /

༈ dus gsum rnam 'dren thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul las// yongs shar sprul pa'i gzugs sku'i rnam par rol// 'gro ba'i mgon du bsnyel med phrin las can// bka' brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'tsho gzhes gsol// 'phags chen byang chub spyod pa'i rang bzhin gyi// snying stobs go cha mchog tu dpa' ba yis// snyigs dus gdul byar 'tshams pa'i dam chos kyi// smin grol ston bzhin bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol// don dam 'pho med rtag bde'i rang bzhin kyang*// snang tshul gzhan rkyen dri ma ring spangs zhing*// rdo rje chos bdun ngo bor lhun grub nas// 'tsho gzhes bzhed don ji ltar 'grub gyur cig / ces dam pa gzhan la'ang mtshan gyi kha bsgyur bde khyad can du/ karma chos mchog nas bskul ltar si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel/// / ༈ phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun lha lam khyon yangs por// mi bzad byin rlabs 'od stong 'char ba'i mthus// deng 'dir gang de'i gsang gsum dga' tshal gyi// legs byas 'dab brgya rnam kun grol gyur cig /spangs rtogs yon tan ge sar 'dzum phreng rgyas// rgyal bstan skyong ba'i lhag blo'i rtsa ba brtan// yid can 'tsho ba'i dpal gyis gang bzhin par// dus kyi nyer 'tshe ring du bsring gyur cig /chos dbyings don dam bden dang chos can gyi// kun rdzob rten 'brel bslu ba med bden pas// ji ltar smon pa'i 'bras gang yongs 'grub nas// dge 'dun sde rgyas 'jig rten bde legs shog / ces grub tsha bla chos kyi ngor si tu pas spel ba dge// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ gdod nas ye shes lnga bdag tshe 'od mgon// dbyer med sangs rgyas pad skyes mthu stobs kyi// thugs rje'i snang byed gang 'dir rab gsal nas// rnam kun 'chi med tshe dbang rgyas gyur cig /rgyal bstan 'dzin dang lus can phan bde'i gzhi// phrin las rmad byung dam pa'i rnam thar ldan// spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan kun 'byung gnas// gsang gsum rtag brtan rdo rje yongs grub shog

/stong nyid gzhom bral rang byung gur khang dbus// ma bcos don dam 'gyur med sku mnga' ba// ye grub mi shigs ngo bor 'tsho gzhes nas// bzhed don yid bzhin 'dod 'jo'i bkra shis shog / ces bla ma dpal dga'i zhabs brtan 'di bzhin kun dga' ye shes pas bskul bar spel ba sarba thā maṅga la shu bha puṣ+ṭiṃ/// / ༈ rgyal ba stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag sangs rgyas dang*// shes rab phar phyin zhi ba chos kyi mchog /rig dang grol ba'i sar gnas 'phags tshogs te// rin chen rnam gsum thugs rjes deng 'dir skyongs// drug pa seng ge karma par grags pa'i// snying po'i ring lugs gsal byed sprul pa'i sku// gsang gsum mi mthun nyer 'tshe las rgyal nas// bstan la bya ba byed pa'i dpal thob shog /'brel tshad gdul byar phan bde'i phrin las dang*// rang don thos bsam sgom par dbang sgyur zhing*// bzhed don rnam dag lhun gyis grub gyur pa'i// dge legs yongs 'du'i bkra shis rab rgyas shog / ces pa'ang gnas sgo sprul pa'i skur dge ba'i shis brjod 'di bzhin bla ma gzhan phan rgya mtshos bskul ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag rdzogs sangs rgyas// brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung gnas dam pa'i chos// lung rtogs yon tan gter mnga' rig grol sde// bla med mchog gsum rgyal bas deng 'dir skyongs// gang sngon byang chub brnyes par gyur mod kyang*// 'gro la brtse chen dgongs zab ma smad pas// gzhan dring mi 'jog snying rje'i thabs tshul gyis// gzugs skur bsam bzhin bzhengs gang rgyal gyur cig /gsang gsum rtag brtan bde ba chen po'i ngang*// lhun grub gzhan rkyen dang bral phrin las kyis// rgya mtsho'i gos can yongs khyab rnam pa kun// bde legs dpal 'bar phyogs las rnam rgyal shog / ces pa'ang grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa sa tham bla ma dbang rgyal rin po che'i sprul sku 'khrul med karma rgya mtsho bde legs dpal 'bar phyogs las rnam rgyal zhes par yun 'tsho'i shis brjod du si tu pas spel ba shu bha mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/// /

༈ sku gsum ston pa mchog gi rnam par 'phrul// mkhas dang grub pa yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rje btsun a rā ga'i// thugs rje chen pos gang 'dir skyong gyur cig /mgon khyod bstan dang 'gro la rjes brtse'i mthus// 'khor ba srid du sprul pa'i rol rtsed kyis// nges gsang bstan spel gdul bya smin grol lam// 'god mdzad mchog gi rnam rol zhabs brtan gsol// 'khor lo gsum gyi bstan pa'i rtsa lag dang*// sgrub brgyud snying po'i ring lugs 'dzin spel skyong*// gzhan dring mi 'jog sngon smon thugs bskyed stobs// deng 'dir yongs smin mdzad phrin lhun grub shog /

ces pa'ang si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis gang de'i bla mchan sprul sku dang dbon po mdzod pa sogs kyi bzhed ngor spel/// / ༈ tshe dang ye shes dpag med bcom ldan 'das// sgyu 'phrul rnam par rgyal ma lha mo'i sku// thugs rje tshad med yid bzhin 'khor lo yi// byin rlabs 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gru char rgyun// gang 'dir sim pa'i legs byas dpal de yis// mi shigs dwangs ma rdo rje'i sku brnyes shing*// bslab gsum rgyud smin thos sgom mthar phyin nas// bstan dang 'gro don lhun gyis grub gyur cig / ces si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sprul sku gsar bzhad la karma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin bzang po zhes pa'i mtshan dang yun 'tsho'i bden tshig gang de'i dbon sprul karma rab sgrub kyis bzhed ltar spel ba dge// / ༈ 'gyur med bde chen thig ler dngos kun gyi// drwa ba sdom pa lhan skyes bcom ldan 'das// rnam kun mchog ldan phyag rgya cher rol pa'i// sgyu 'phrul 'gro blo'i grangs snyed bstan pa las// gnod gnas dbang pos skyong ba'i ljongs kyi dpyid// bsod nams rdul brtsegs mchog sku'i zla gzhon gang*// 'chi med gnyug ma'i cha shas rab rdzogs pa'i// 'od snang bstan 'gro'i dpal du rtag 'char bas// bslab pa gsum dang thos bsam sgom pa yis// ston pa'i bstan pa ches cher spel ba dang*// rdzogs ldan dang po'i dpal 'byor rgya mtsho yis// lus can bde dgar spyod pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa'ang si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis gtsang chen mchog gi sprul pa'i sku zla gsar bzhad pa'i yun 'tsho'i ched du bskul bar spel dge dza yan+tu/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ rgyal kun 'dus zhal rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam mkha' gro chos skyong tshogs rnams kyi// thugs bskyed bden pa zab mos sprul pa'i sku// bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal 'tsho gzhes brtan gyur cig

/bslab gsum rnam dag rin chen rgyan gyis spras// stobs bcu'i bdag nyid spos glang ji bzhin par// sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i khur 'degs ngal med cing*// thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin 'tsho brtan shog /gzhan don snying rje'i khyung sngon skyes drangs pa'i// rang don chos sku gnyug ma'i nyin byed gang*// mdo sngags ring lugs pad tshal bzhad pa'i gnyen// yongs grub gsang gsum gzhom bral brtan gyur cig / ces si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis gter sgar rgyal sras sprul sku yun 'tsho'i ched du dbon bla ma karma tshe rgyal ngor spel/// / ༈ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i rang gzugs mchog /dpal ldan sangs rgyas mtsho skyes rnam par rol// bsam bzhin skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar// zhing 'dir bskal brgyar 'tsho gzhes brtan gyur cig /bskal bzang sangs rgyas drug pa seṅge'i mtshan// zhing 'dir karma ka zhes sa gsum du// grags pa'i 'od dkar can de'i ring lugs gang*// phrin las phyogs mthar spel bzhin 'tsho gzhes gsol// dkon mchog rtsa gsum byin rlabs mthu stobs dang*// chos can chos nyid rten 'brel bslu med kyis// gsang gsum rdo rje'i chos bdun ngo bo ru// bstan 'gro'i don chen mthar phyin bkra shis shog / dpal ldan dpa' bo rin po che'i mchog sprul zhabs brtan du/ dbon bsod nams thogs med nas bskul ngor spel ba dza ya/// / ༈ rgyal mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug karma pa'i// phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos can spel ba'i phyir// byang sems kun tu bzang po'i rnam par rol// gang khyod gsang gsum 'tsho gzhes brtan gyur cig /mkhyen pas shes dang shes bya thugs su chud// brtse bas snyigs ma'i gdul bya rjes su 'dzin// nus pas mi srun bdud sde pha mthar bskrad// dam pa'i skyes mchog bskal par 'tsho brtan gsol// khyad par nges don snying po'i chos sgo yis// 'gro khams legs pa'i lam mchog ston byed pa'i// 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bzhin du// ston mchog ring lugs shing rta 'dren gyur cig

/ rgyal tshab phyag mdzod bzhed ltar mchog sprul rin po che'i zhabs brtan rten 'byung ched du spel ba dge// / ༈ rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun 'dus pa'i sku// dpal ldan karma pa yi nges don gyi// ring lugs chos kyi nyi ma yongs 'char ba// rtag par 'tsho gzhes phrin las rgyas gyur cig /snying po'i don brgyud bstan gsal sngon smon mthus// 'bras bzang smin pa'i stobs las grub pa yi// 'gro ba'i dpal dang dpung gnyen gang dag rnams// bar chad nyer 'tshe las grol 'tsho brtan shog /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// dge 'dun rnams kyang bslab gsum chos ldan zhing*// rgyal khams bde zhing mi mthun rgud pa zhi// bkra shis bde legs lhun gyis 'grub gyur cig / drung ram sprul sku gnyis la yun 'tsho kho pa dam chos ngor spel/// / ༈ rdo rje'i tshe la dbang sgyur dkyil 'khor lha// gtso mchog pad+mā ka ra'i mkha' klong la// thugs rje'i sprin tshogs 'dus pa'i gru char gyis// deng 'dir 'chi med yongs grub byin gyis rlobs// mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud ring lugs kyi// 'dzin spel skyong ba'i phrin las shing rta pa// karma ye shes bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog /bstan dang 'gro don spel phyir 'tsho gzhes gsol// sngon tshe gzhan phan byang chub thugs bskyed nas// spyod pa rmad byung rjes su dgongs pa yis// snyigs lnga'i gdul byar lhag par brtse chen gyis// zhing 'dir 'tsho gzhes bzhed don lhun grub shog / khra legs pa'i zhabs gras phan bde'i ngor spel/// / ༈ dpal ldan mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i zab gter 'chang*// rig pa 'dzin dbang la li ta badz+ra// gang 'dul sprul pa'i rol rtsed yang 'char ba// bstan 'gro'i mgon du zhing 'dir 'tsho gzhes gsol// rnam dag bslab gsum yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel// mi mthun mkha' yi glang pos ma gos par// rgyal mchog phyag na pad 'chang karma pa'i// ring lugs kun+da'i dga' tshal rgyas byed shog

/bslu med rtsa gsum thugs rje'i 'od stong gis// bar chad nyes tshogs khri mun rgyang bsrings nas// phun tshogs lnga ldan dpal la dbang 'byor ba'i// snang ba dam pas rtag par skyong gyur cig / ces gter sprul yun 'tsho'i ched du ban dbon karma mthar phyin ngor spel ba dge/ dza yan+tu/// / ༈ sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes mchog rdo rje 'chang*// ngo mtshar rnam rol rgyal kun phrin las kyi// gsang ba'i mdzod 'chang grub pa o rgyan mtshan// gang gi rang bzhin bsam mi khyab pa'i 'phrul// rnal 'byor karma tiṣ+ṭha bstan dang 'gro'i// phan bde'i snang ba spel phyir gsang ba gsum// ye shes rdo rje gzhom bral rtag brtan gyi// ngo bo nyid du yun ring 'tsho gzhes nas// dam pa'i spyod pas mos ldan smin cing grol// thar pa'i lam bzang mchog la spyod gyur cig / ces dbon pad+ma mgon gyi g.yar ngor spel/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ gdod nas 'gyur med rang byung ye shes rtsal// bde chen lhun grub longs spyod yongs rdzogs pa// sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rang gzugs sna tshogs kyi// phrin las gar ston dpal ldan karma pa// mchog gi ring lugs nges don snying po'i bstan// rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgreng ba'i dpal mnga' ba// bsam bzhin sprul pa'i zlos gar nyi zla zung*// gsang gsum rdo rje'i khams su 'tsho brtan shog /chos dbyings rtag pa don dam 'pho bral dang*// gzhan rkyen chu 'dzin dri ma rgyang bsring nas// bskal par 'tsho brtan bsdu bzhi chos bcu yi// snang bas kun gsal 'dzam gling rgyan du shog / ces pa'ang zur mang gar bstan sprul pa'i sku lhan rgyas yun 'tshor dbon bla ma gnyis nas bskul ngor spel/// / ༈ 'gro mgon pad+mā kā ra'i thugs rje'i 'od// nyin byed lha dbang rdo rje rtse brgya pas// mi mthun bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs gzhom bzhin du// sgrub brgyud bstan pa~X 'dzin skyong mthar phyin pa'i// rnam bzhi'i phri~Xn la~Xs ra~Xb rgya~Xs yongs grub cing*// dam pa'i rnam thar zab mo'i rgyun bskyang nas// lus can 'gro ba'i phan bde'i rtsa lag tu// rtag par 'tsho brtan 'gro don lhun 'grub shog

/de ltar rab dkar lhag blo puṇ+ḍā ri// ji bzhin mchog gsum thugs rje bskul ba'i mthus// smon pa yongs grub dge 'dun sde rgyas shing*// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa'i dpal gyur cig / ces blo mchog ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ swasti/ ston pa bder gshegs stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag mchog /lung rtogs yon tan 'byung gnas dam pa'i chos// rig dang grol ba'i sar gnas tshogs mchog sde// bla med dam pa'i thugs rjes skyong rgyur cig /nges gsang ring lugs dri med 'dzin pa'i bdag /gang de'i gsang gsum gzhom bral g.yo med pa// bskal brgyar 'tsho brtan phrin las snang ba yis// rgya mtsho'i go can khyab pa'i bkra shis shog / ces bya btang sprul skur sde ba bstan rnam ngor smon lam du spel/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid// sku gsum bdag nyid mtsho skyes pad+ma 'byung*// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i skur ston lha tshogs la// sgo gsum rtse gcig gsol btab bden pa yis// 'chi med rdo rje dwangs ma'i sku brnyes shing*// rnam dag bslab gsum ljon pa'i rtsa ba brtan// thos bsam sgrub dang sgom pa'i lo 'dab rgyas// rim gnyis mchog gi 'bras bzang myur smin shog /'phags nor bdun dang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi// phar phyin drug ldan rang gzhan don mthar phyin// zhi sogs rab 'byams phrin las dbang bsgyur nas// 'gro khams rgya mtsho'i don chen lhun 'grub shog /rgyal bstan spyi dang sgrub brgyud nges don gyi// ring lugs rgyal mtshan mi nub srid rtser bsgreng*// stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres chos la sogs// rgyud smin sku bzhi'i go 'phang mngon gyur shog / skyo brag bstan snying sprul sku la yun 'tsho'i bzhed ltar spel ba dge// / ༈ rgyal kun spyi gzugs thod phreng rtsal// rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs kyis// rgyal bstan 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug gang*// rgyal mchog tshe 'od mgon ji ltar// gang zhig bskal brgyar brtan bzhugs 'tshal// gang dag mi mthun nyer zhi zhing*// gang gi phrin las rgya mtsho'i dpal// gang rnams mi nub rab rgyas shog
/ ces u rgyan tshe dbang gis bskul ngor karma rnam rgyal rdo rje rab brtan gyi brtan bzhugs rgyur si tus brjod pa dge// /
